summary: Design an inventory/reservation module split: inventory owns stock, reservation owns hold lifecycle, with an explicit dependency direction and a forbidden reverse dependency.
goal: Make stock ownership independently reusable (e.g. for a future multi-warehouse module) without carrying hold/TTL/authZ concerns, before the reservation domain grows further.

in_scope.text: Define inventory and reservation as separate modules with a directed dependency (reservation -> inventory) and a forbidden reverse dependency (inventory -> reservation)

out_of_scope.text: Implementing the split in src/ — this change stays a structural design artifact; the sample's implementation intentionally remains a single reservation.ts file
Any behavior change, new endpoint, or new OCL/TLA+ contract

success_criteria.text: ArchitecturePlan documents module responsibilities, the reservation -> inventory dependency, and the inventory -> reservation forbid_dependency constraint, and passes solidsdd-lint / critique(architecture_plan) cleanly
